what: Floating decorations like balloons, bubbles and stars drift with parallax by their own speed multiplier e — while passing from the bottom to the top of the screen they shift from +50e% to −50e% of their own height (scrub 1, following 1 second late), and the start and end are pulled by −50e% so the decoration passes its resting spot within the screen. The larger the multiplier, the faster it passes and the more it seems to be in front (.25~8)

options.speed: Speed multiplier e, default 1 — 0 stays still. Brand balloon .25·.5·.75, stars 2·5, balls 3·4·8
options.scrub: Trailing delay (sec), default 1 — if true, immediate

note: GSAP uses transform, so give tilt through the rotate property (rotate: 10deg)

from.where: shared.js parallax — .mr-px[data-speed] balloons·soap bubbles·stars·balls·ribbons (original ParallaxImage speed 0~8)
